classification: G1 / NO_GOVERNING_PHYSICS_CHANGE / RESEARCH_ONLY / RETROSPECTIVE / TARGET_EXPOSED / SOURCE_INTERNAL / NONSCORING

calibration.pixel_origin: top-left; native integer pixel centers; x right, y down
calibration.transform: t=80*(x-78)/1469; q=7*(943-y)/865; uncertain anchors vary independently +/-1 px; positive orientation required
calibration.dependence: One shared affine calibration is physically admitted; computations use conservative pointwise outer relaxation containing every global choice, not independent calibration evidence.

masks.reason: axis labels, text and outer whitespace; black axes excluded also by colour mask
all legend samples, text, frame; known legacy yellow 65.01 s /3.3948 g/s is legend ink at native x~1272,y~104
saturation below 0.25 excludes black axes/ticks and text

colour_rules.space: HSV from native decoded JPEG RGB; hue degrees; saturation>=0.25; value>=0.15

style_rules.rule: Colour alone supplies replacement mass. Generic source-ink fragments have ambiguous style. Definite solid regions below are visually recognized from continuity and context, never from flow magnitude or run rank.

gap_rule.bridge: Only selected blue solid corridor, or visually audited solid bundles: bounded other-colour/raster occlusions. Blue missing columns use full endpoint ordinate hull expanded by 4px, not a physical smoothness claim. All intervening values are assumed within this hull; conclusion conditional on this graphical rule. Known dash/dot gaps are never bridged.
gap_rule.unknown_gap: UNSUPPORTED: no finite enclosure; no renormalization

identity_rule: Generic fragments are maximal one-to-one adjacent-column ink-run chains; branch/merge terminates identity. They are connected raster fragments, not shots. Selected blue corridor is isolated from other blue branches; no rank-following across same-colour crossing. Bundles enclose all retained continuations without labeling individual trajectories.
phase_rule: Before comparison, selected regions are GRAPHICAL_INTERIOR because baseline departures precede them and visible continuation follows. A terminal candidate requires a falling branch continuing to a near-baseline endpoint/tail; low or falling flow alone is insufficient. Operational brewing phase remains UNRESOLVED. Other ink is UNRESOLVED unless audited region assigns startup, terminal-candidate or tail.
clipping: Any retained target touching an axis boundary lacks a finite enclosure of unseen continuation. Do not cap at 0 or7. Whole affected window unsupported. Yellow top contact x188..192,y78..82 and right blue contact x1637..1639,y~770..880 explicitly retained as censoring diagnostics.

window_design.remainders: Keep [0,1.5] sensitivity leading and all terminal remainders; no full-window status for remainders. Every fragment/bundle has every domain window request, including unsupported requests.
window_design.comparisons: All ordered pairs of complete interior windows on each persistent fragment; all successive triples; constant intersection across all maximal supported windows per lattice. All 18 fixed-setting fines pairs on every common complete interior window; 0 versus1/2/4 primary.
window_design.multiplier: All fixed persistent fragment pairings per intended condition pair. Use every maximal common supported interior window per lattice, no interval search or partner switching; at least2 complete common windows. Union of intersections over fixed alternatives. Bundles with unresolved persistent identity cannot supply multiplier evidence.

units: Derivative of beverage mass, g/s; literal published time, s. Not volumetric flow, puck throughput or permeability.
reading_uncertainty: Graphical enclosure allowances only; not lab error bars, replicate uncertainty, confidence intervals or bounds on balance response.
